reviewer.version: codex-cli 0.171.0-alpha.13 (read at triage; the binary self-updates)

rawOutputNote: Byte-identical copy of the owner's ~/Downloads/codex-082-t002.json (6694 bytes), unedited.
triageMethod: Orchestrator re-read of every cited line at develop (082 spec unchanged since 37077da8) and of SPEC-083 REQ-004/REQ-010/REQ-011 and SPEC-049 D1; each claim treated as a hypothesis to refute. S82-004 changed the plan of an owner decision, so the owner chose the resolution interactively. No code run or edited.

triage.evidence: SC-011 refused any result whose bytes match an earlier run's; two independent deterministic runs can write the same score file, and a reused result can differ only in metadata.
triage.action: REQ-011/SC-011, T014 and procedure_011: reuse is detected by provenance (register-issued nonce, run id and workspace id in the result; fresh workspace and empty caches recorded); byte-identical independent results are accepted.

triage.evidence: REQ-005 put hashes of private bytes in the public manifest while SC-005 refused private identity hashes in the public tree, and 'no private task byte' had no matching unit.
triage.action: REQ-005/SC-005, T004, T007, plan and procedure_005: public salted commitments (secret salt in the private store) versus forbidden plain identity hashes and task ids; scan unit is each private line of at least 40 characters absent from the public tree.

triage.evidence: SC-008 and procedure_008 accepted any two labeled records, while the T001 OD-4 (d) decision requires blind Claude and Codex reviews with model and version, two cross-critiques and owner adjudication.
triage.action: REQ-008/SC-008, T012 and procedure_008 now require and order those artifacts (blind hashes before either critique) before qa-passed.

triage.evidence: SPEC-083 REQ-004 draws gate tasks only from the private split and REQ-010 needs T >= 20; under OD-1 (20-50) and OD-7 (20 % by lineage) the private split holds about 4 to 10 tasks, so no regression verdict is reachable even when H1 holds.
triage.action: Owner decision 2026-11-24 ('Objetivo aparte, solo descriptivo'): REQ-013/SC-013, Risks and T016 add a separate feasibility target of 20 qa-passed private-holdout tasks; SPEC-083 stays descriptive-only until later lineage batches reach it; OD-1 and OD-7 unchanged.

triage.evidence: 'Shared spec feature' and 'fixture base' were undefined, and no transitive closure or evidence rule existed, so two reviewers could partition differently.
triage.action: REQ-004, T006 and plan: operational definitions (same specs/NNN-* directory or SPEC number; same test module or fixture file), relation edges with evidence, lineages as connected components, undecidable pairs recorded as unresolved and merged.

triage.evidence: SC-004 refused any assigned L3, while SPEC-049 D1 keeps L3 unassigned only until its relation to L1 is resolved.
triage.action: SC-004, T004 and procedure_004: refusal only for an unresolved L3; resolved L3 joined to L1 or standing alone validates.

triage.evidence: REQ-002 required PR number, commits and merge date for every task, which synthetic SPEC-049 cases cannot supply.
triage.action: REQ-002/SC-002, T004 and T008: origin-specific provenance with explicit not-applicable values, each origin validated against its own field set.

triage.evidence: The selection rule said the test 'fails at the parent commit', but a test added by the fix does not exist there; collection or setup failures were not distinguished.
triage.action: REQ-003, T005 and plan: the fix's test and fixture changes are applied onto the parent tree; failure classes recorded and the counted ones frozen; collection or setup errors of the test itself never count; network, native-host and skipped tests excluded.

triage.evidence: OD-5 did not fix whether the 10 % counts attempts or trials, how reruns resolve, or how a quota stop combines with the threshold (SPEC-083 calls a quota-stopped run inconclusive).
triage.action: REQ-009/SC-009, T014 and procedure_009: unit is the registered trial (at most three attempts, outcome of the first non-infra attempt), threshold over registered trials, invalid takes precedence over a quota stop, otherwise stopped (SPEC-083 inconclusive). This reading of OD-5 is the orchestrator's; the owner may revise it before T014.

triage.evidence: Public corpus/reviews and corpus/contamination.json per-task rows could describe or date a private task.
triage.action: REQ-005, T012 and T013: private-holdout review, exploit and contamination details stay in the private store; the public tree holds receipts (counts and salted commitments).

limits: Independent model review, not human review or approval. It grants no authority. Findings were applied to documentation only; no code exists yet.
